description: This C# source file contains unit tests for stress testing DynamoDB storage within an AWS-based environment, using the xUnit testing framework. It defines the class DynamoDBStorageStressTests which implements various stress tests such as write and read operations under high load conditions, with multiple partitions.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageStressTests
classes.description: A test class for performing stress tests on DynamoDB storage, including high-volume read/write operations.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManagerStressTests_WriteAlot_SinglePartition
methods.description: Performs a stress test by writing a large number of entries to a single partition.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManagerStressTests_WriteAlot_MultiPartition
methods.description: Performs a stress test by writing a large number of entries across multiple partitions.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManagerStressTests_ReadAll_SinglePartition
methods.description: Performs a read operation to retrieve all entries from a single partition after stress-writing data.

methods.name: WriteAlot_Async
methods.description: Helper method to perform multiple asynchronous upsert operations with batching, measuring performance during stress tests.
